core_memory.customer_profile: Name: Michael. Age: 35. Seattle. Freelance graphic designer, works from home. Values design-forward gadgets that fit his lifestyle. First-time customer. Interested in high-quality coffee machines(drip + espresso) to upgrade morning routine.
core_memory.design_preference: Prefers sleek, modern, stainless-steel finish on appliances. Design buff—look and feel of product matters a lot.
core_memory.promo_interest: Asked about first-time buyer discounts, the 'New Customer Discount' seen on homepage, bundle deals, and limited-time promos. Wants pricing range for espresso machines.
core_memory.shipping_needs: Located in Seattle. Concerned about rainy-weather deliveries. Wants to know if we ship from local warehouse or out of state, approximate shipping timeframes. Needs product before a family gathering later this month(time-sensitive).
core_memory.referral_and_priorities: Referred by friend(bought air fryer/blender, praised our support). Big coffee lover. Wants machine matching routine: brew frequency/capacity, cleaning, counter footprint. Brew temp is make-or-break: past drip makers not hot enough, microwaves coffee; wants adjustable temp/reliably hot.
core_memory.counter_space: Kitchen not tiny but counter already crowded with appliances. Willing to rearrange(move toaster oven, reorganize spice rack) but wants to mentally prepare. Wants exact machine dimensions before buying to plan footprint.
core_memory.warranty_concern: Wants to confirm warranty/quality guarantee on coffee machines. Had bad past experiences with other brands: short warranty periods and difficult service when things went wrong. Hopes our policy is more accommodating, especially for higher-end models.
